title: TRIAD: a transposition-based approach for gene mutagenesis by random short in-frame insertions and deletions for directed protein evolution
protocol: Isolate TransDel or TransIns from pUC57 by restriction digestion with BglII.
Perform separate reactions for TransDel and TransIns.
Incubate the reaction mixture containing pUC57-Transposon, FastDigest BglII, and 10x FastDigest Green buffer at 37 °C for 30 minutes.
Separate the resulting DNA products by agarose gel electrophoresis.
Extract the fragment corresponding to the transposon (around 1 kb).
Incubate the reaction mixture for 1 to 2 hours at 30°C.
Heat-inactivate the reaction by incubating for 10 min at 75°C.
Purify and concentrate DNA to 10 μl in nuclease-free water.
Transform purified transposition product (corresponding to 3 to 15 ng of plasmid DNA) into electrocompetent E. coli.
Mix up to 2.5 µl or up to 5 µl of purified transposition product with 25 µl or 50 µl of electrocompetent cells, respectively.
Set voltage to 1.8 kV when using 1 mm gap electroporation cuvettes (use up to 2.5 kV for 2 mm gap).
Add Recovery Medium (or SOC medium) to a final volume of 300 µl and incubate 1 hour under agitation at 37°C.
Plate up to 250 µl of this transformed culture mix on LB-Agar supplemented with 100 µg/ml ampicillin and 34 µg/ml chloramphenicol (LB-Agar Amp + Cam) and incubate overnight at 37°C.
Scrape colonies from a 14 cm Petri Dish containing transformed cells in 6 mL LB and transfer into three 2-ml Eppendorf tubes.
Pellet cells by centrifugation.
Extract plasmid pool from one tube using a Midiprep kit (store the other two as back-ups).
Collect cell pellet by centrifugation if cells were grown in liquid culture.
Extract plasmid directly from the collected pellet using a Midiprep kit.
Digest transposon plasmid library using FastDigest RE1.
Digest transposon plasmid library using FastDigest RE2.
Incubate the reaction mixture for 30 minutes at 37°C.
Separate the resulting fragments by agarose gel electrophoresis.
Isolate the band corresponding to the GOI with transposon.
Purify the DNA from the isolated agarose gel band.
Ligate the GOI containing the transposon into the target vector in a ratio of 1:3 to 5 (vector/insert).
Perform ligation reaction using T4 DNA ligase.
Incubate the reaction mixture for 30 minutes at room temperature or overnight at 16 °C.
Purify and concentrate the ligation product in 10 µl nuclease-free water.
Transform purified ligation mix (corresponding to 2.5 to 25 ng of plasmid DNA) into electrocompetent E. coli cells.
Plate 0.1 to 0.5% of transformed cells on LB-Agar Amp + Cam to estimate the transposon insertion library size.
Collect cells after growth and extract the plasmid pool corresponding to the transposon insertion library.
Remove the TransDel transposon by digesting the TransDel insertion library plasmid pool with SchI.
Incubate the reaction mixture for 30 minutes at 37 °C.
Heat-inactivate the reaction mixture for 5 minutes at 80 °C.
Separate the resulting fragments by agarose gel electrophoresis.
Extract the digestion product corresponding to the target vector containing the GOI.
Re-circularise the linear single nucleotide triplet deletion plasmid by intramolecular ligation.
Incubate the reaction mixture for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Purify and concentrate ligation product in 10 µl nuclease-free water.
Transform purified ligation mix into electrocompetent E. coli cells.
Plate up to 250 μl of transformed culture mix on LB-Agar Amp (100 µg/ml) and incubate overnight at 37 °C.
Alternatively, inoculate 10 mL liquid LB Amp with the transformed culture mix and incubate overnight under agitation at 37 °C.
Estimate library size by plating 0.1 to 0.5% of transformed cells on LB-Agar Amp and extrapolating the number of transformants from resulting colonies.
Collect cells after growth.
Extract plasmid library pool corresponding to single nucleotide triplet deletion library.
Store resulting single nucleotide triplet library as a DNA solution.
Reconstitute pUC57-Del2 (or Del3) with Fast-digest SmaI.
Add 10x FastDigest Green buffer to the mixture.
Add nuclease-free water to reach a final volume of 20 μl.
Incubate the reaction at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Separate the resulting fragments by agarose gel electrophoresis.
Extract the digestion product corresponding to the selection cassette (around 1 kb).
Perform blunt-end ligation with single triplet deletion plasmid library and selection cassette in a ratio of 1 vs. 5 to 10 (vector/insert).
Add T4 DNA ligase and 10x T4 DNA Ligase buffer.
Add nuclease-free water to reach a final volume of 20 μl for the ligation reaction.
Incubate the ligation reaction at room temperature for 30 minutes or overnight at 16°C.
Purify and concentrate the ligation product in 10 μl nuclease-free water.
Transform purified ligation mix (corresponding to 2.5 to 25 ng of plasmid DNA) into electrocompetent E. coli cells.
Use culture media supplemented with 50 µg/ml kanamycin.
Collect cells and extract plasmid library pool corresponding to Del2 or Del3 insertion library.
Digest the cassette insertion library plasmid pool with SchI to remove Del2 or Del3 selection cassette.
Re-circularise the double or triple nucleotide triplet plasmid library by intramolecular ligation.
Transform purified ligation mix into electrocompetent E. coli cells.
Collect cells and extract plasmid library pool corresponding to double or triple nucleotide triplet deletion library.
Store resulting libraries in the form of DNA solutions.
Prepare InsX selection cassette by double-digestion of pUC57-InsX with NotI and SchI.
Incubate the reaction mixture for 30 minutes at 37 °C.
Heat-inactivate the reaction mixture for 5 minutes at 80 °C.
Separate the fragments by agarose gel electrophoresis.
Extract the digestion product corresponding to the selection cassette (around 1.15 kb, second fragment in descending size order).
Remove the TransIns transposon by sequential double-digestion of pUC57-InsX with NotI and SchI.
Incubate the reaction mixture for 30 minutes at 37 °C.
Heat-inactivate the reaction mixture for 5 minutes at 80 °C.
Separate the resulting fragments by agarose gel electrophoresis.
Extract the digestion product corresponding to the target vector containing the GOI.
Ligate the InsX selection cassette in the linearised plasmid library obtained.
Transform purified ligation mix into electrocompetent E. coli cells.
Collect cells after growth.
Extract plasmid library pool corresponding to InsX insertion library.
Remove InsX selection cassette by digesting with Eco57I.
Incubate 20 µl reaction mixture at 37 °C for 30 minutes.
Heat-inactivate the reaction mixture at 80 °C for 5 minutes.
Separate the resulting fragments by agarose gel electrophoresis.
Extract the digestion product corresponding to the target vector containing the GOI.
Perform reaction in NEB buffer 2 supplemented with 33 µM of each dNTP (132 µM total dNTPs).
Incubate reaction for 15 min at 25 °C.
Stop digestion by adding EDTA (around 10 mM final) and heating for 20 min at 80 °C.
Purify resulting DNA product in 10 µl Nuclease-free water.
Re-circularise the insertion plasmid library by intramolecular ligation.
Transform purified ligation mix into electrocompetent E. coli cells.
Collect cells after growth.
Extract plasmid library pool corresponding to single, double or triple nucleotide triplet insertion library.
